name: Falcon 9 Block 5 | SpainSat NG I
description: First of two new-generation satellites built by Airbus to provide secure communications to the Spanish government, its allies, and various international organizations.

landing.description: The Falcon 9 booster B1073 was expended during this mission.

timeline.label: Startup
timeline.description: The onboard computer takes control over the countdown and runs last checks

timeline.label: GO for Launch
